decisions.reason: This glazed industrial sectional door stayed on the website through 2019 and fits the firm's core industrial door business, so keeping the option costs little, though it may overlap with Product F and later be merged into it.

The insulated glazed variant meets demand for energy-efficient industrial buildings, survived the early pruning that removed the garage door products, and shares production with the core range, making it cheap to keep.
Having its own dedicated page in both observed years signals that the firm has committed further to this product, and nothing in the results suggests its value will fail to materialize.
